_resultsDebrief.title: Results Debrief
_resultsDebrief.description: Consolidated post-assessment study plan showing lessons to revisit based on incorrect answers

_isEnabled.title: Enable results debrief
_isEnabled.description: When true, a study plan is shown after assessment completion. When false or absent, the extension does nothing.

_assessmentId.title: Assessment ID
_assessmentId.description: The assessment ID to apply the debrief to.

_studyPlanHeading.title: Study plan heading
_studyPlanHeading.description: Heading displayed above the study plan list.

_passRevealNote.title: Pass reveal note
_passRevealNote.description: Note shown on pass, typically informing the learner they can now view correct answers.

_items.title: Question-to-lesson mapping
_items.description: Maps each question component ID to its topic and lesson.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Brief description of what the question tests.

lessonTitle.title: Lesson title
lessonTitle.description: The displayTitle of the lesson to revisit.
